text: The combination of painless jaundice, weight loss, and an enlarged gallbladder without stones is highly suggestive of a malignancy obstructing the bile duct. Do you have any history of smoking or chronic pancreatitis, and have you noticed any itching on your skin?

text: I do smoke a pack of cigarettes a day and drink about five alcoholic beverages daily, but I have no history of pancreatitis. I haven't noticed any itching on my skin, though I have been having trouble sleeping well.

text: Your symptoms and test results strongly point towards pancreatic cancer, specifically a tumor in the head of the pancreas causing biliary obstruction. DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma
